facts.business: Gujjubhai Industries Limited (formerly Sumuka Agro Industries Limited) is an FMCG company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of consumer products including Himalayan Salt, with a diversified product portfolio and distribution across modern and general trade channels.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions during FY 2025-26 include: (1) VKRS Hospitality Private Limited - Reimbursement of Expenses ₹4.81 lakhs (closing balance ₹4.49 lakhs) and Purchases ₹2.03 lakhs; (2) Allysum Ventures Private Limited - Sales ₹364.84 lakhs (closing balance ₹0) and Purchases ₹47.65 lakhs (closing balance ₹0). All transactions at arm's length basis.
